chunks: The day We shall move the mountains, and you see the earth an open plain, We shall gather them together, leaving none behind.

key_terms.نُسَيِّرُ: We shall move or cause to pass

ai.seo_question: What happens to the mountains and the earth on the Day of Resurrection according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the 'laying bare' of the earth (Barzakh) signifies the removal of all veils and layers of concealment, revealing the raw reality of creation for judgment. This imagery underscores the absolute precision of divine accounting, where every soul is gathered without omission, reflecting the Shia emphasis on the comprehensiveness of God's knowledge and justice on the Day of Reckoning.
